faults.quote: Nos gusta tomar una copa de vino rojo con la cena.
faults.why: 'Red wine' is 'vino tinto' in Spanish; 'vino rojo' is an English calque.

faults.quote: Do not confuse vino (wine) with viene (comes, from the verb venir).
faults.why: The actual homonym is 'vino' (he/she came, preterite of 'venir'), not 'viene', and 'vino tinto' is a much more important note.
